stages.label: Source
stages.note: My year in open source, written as a Fortran program. Follow 100 + 100 as it moves through the compiler.
stages.text:
program atharva
  implicit none
  integer :: merged, opened, issues, commits, reviews, packages

  merged = 100
  opened = 100 + 100
  issues = 200
  commits = 300
  reviews = 30
  packages = 3

  print "(i0,a)", merged, "+ PRs merged"
  print "(i0,a)", opened, "+ PRs opened"
  print "(i0,a)", issues, "+ issues reported"
  print "(i0,a)", commits, "+ commits"
  print "(i0,a)", reviews, "+ code reviews"
  print "(i0,a)", packages, " real Fortran packages compiled"
  print "(a)", "128-bit REAL(16) support built"
  print "(a)", "Hacktoberfest Super Contributor"
end program atharva
